description: This file implements the Ocdm class and factory functions related to the Open Content Decryption Module (OCDM) within the firebolt::rialto::server namespace. It manages creation and access to OCDM instances and checks for support of specific content types.

classes.name: OcdmFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and managing singleton instances of IOcdm.

classes.name: IOcdmFactory
classes.description: Interface for the OCDM factory, providing creation method.

classes.name: Ocdm
classes.description: Implementation of the IOcdm interface, providing content support checks.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IOcdmFactory instance.

methods.name: getOcdm
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the singleton IOcdm instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: isTypeSupported
methods.description: Checks if a given key system type is supported by the OCDM.
